实验设计
研究类型Bulk RNA-seq
物种Homo sapiens
样本数12
分组Tumor (6) / Normal (6)
测序信息
测序平台Illumina NovaSeq 6000
读长PE 150bp
数据量~45 GB (raw)
分析软件
质控FastQC v0.12.1
比对STAR v2.7.11a
定量featureCounts v2.0.3
差异分析DESeq2 v1.40.2
数据编号
GEOGSEXXXXXX
SRRSRR1 - SRR12
参考基因组GRCh38 (hg38)
Snakefile
############################################# # Paper2Pipeline - Auto-generated Snakefile # Source: GSEXXXXXX (Tumor vs Normal) # Generated: 2026-06-20 ############################################# configfile: "config.yaml" rule all: input: expand("qc/{sample}_fastqc.html", sample=config["samples"]), "counts/gene_counts.tsv", "results/degs.tsv", "results/volcano.png" rule fastqc: input: "raw/{sample}.fastq.gz" output: "qc/{sample}_fastqc.html" shell: "fastqc {input} -o qc/" rule trimming: input: "raw/{sample}.fastq.gz" output: r1="trimmed/{sample}_R1.trimmed.fastq.gz", r2="trimmed/{sample}_R2.trimmed.fastq.gz" shell: "trimmomatic PE -threads 8 {input} " "{output.r1} /dev/null {output.r2} /dev/null " "SLIDINGWINDOW:4:20 MINLEN:36" rule star_align: input: r1="trimmed/{sample}_R1.trimmed.fastq.gz", r2="trimmed/{sample}_R2.trimmed.fastq.gz" output: "bam/{sample}.Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.bam" params: idx=config["star_index"] threads: 16 shell: "STAR --runThreadN {threads} " "--genomeDir {params.idx} " "--readFilesIn {input.r1} {input.r2} " "--readFilesCommand zcat " "--outFileNamePrefix bam/{wildcards.sample}. " "--outSAMtype BAM SortedByCoordinate " "--quantMode GeneCounts" rule count: input: "bam/{sample}.Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.bam" output: "counts/{sample}.tsv" params: gtf=config["gtf"] shell: "featureCounts -T 8 -a {params.gtf} " "-o {output} {input}" rule merge_counts: input: expand("counts/{sample}.tsv", sample=config["samples"]) output: "counts/gene_counts.tsv" script: "scripts/merge_counts.R" rule deseq2: input: "counts/gene_counts.tsv" output: deg="results/degs.tsv", volcano="results/volcano.png" script: "scripts/run_deseq2.R"
environment.yml
name: paper2pipeline-env channels: - bioconda - conda-forge - defaults dependencies: - python=3.11 - fastqc=0.12.1 - trimmomatic=0.39 - star=2.7.11a - subread=2.0.3 # featureCounts - r-base=4.3.2 - r-deseq2=1.40.2 - r-ggplot2=3.4.4 - r-pheatmap=1.0.12 - r-enhanceplot=1.14.0 - snakemake=8.12.1 - samtools=1.19 - pandas - biopython # 安装方式： # conda env create -f environment.yml # conda activate paper2pipeline-env
SRA 数据 prefetch SRR1234567 SRR1234568 SRR1234569 SRR1234570 SRR1234571 SRR1234572
格式转换 fastq-dump --split-files --gzip SRR1234567
参考基因组 wget https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gencode/Gencode_human/release_44/GRCh38.primary_assembly.genome.fa.gz
GTF 注释 wget https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gencode/Gencode_human/release_44/gencode.v44.annotation.gtf.gz
STAR 索引 STAR --runThreadN 16 --runMode genomeGenerate --genomeDir star_index/ --genomeFastaFiles GRCh38.primary_assembly.genome.fa --sjdbGTFfile gencode.v44.annotation.gtf --sjdbOverhang 149
资源估算
原始数据：~45 GB
比对后 BAM：~60 GB
STAR 索引：~35 GB
推荐内存：>= 32 GB
推荐线程：>= 16
预计运行时间：~6-8 小时
核心功能

为什么选择 Paper2Pipeline

🧠

智能文献解析

利用大语言模型结合生物信息学领域规则，从方法学章节自动提取实验设计、软件版本、参数设置等关键信息。

⚙

可运行流程骨架

生成完整的 Snakemake 规则文件，包含输入输出定义、软件依赖和执行顺序，改改路径就能跑。

🔧

环境配置锁定

输出 conda environment.yml，锁定每个软件的精确版本，减少环境冲突带来的复现失败。

📤

数据下载与资源预估

自动识别 GEO / SRA 数据编号，生成下载命令，并提供数据量和计算资源的参考估算。
